i_beam.sheet: PC-1Q PDF p1 SECTION B-B series; properties from BDG 6.60.01 p125
geometry_notes: PC-1Q SECTION B-B midspan outlines: four fully dimensioned straight flange/haunch/web profiles with 3/4 in bottom-soffit chamfers.

Historical BDG 6.60.01 (issued 02/14/11, PDF p125) prints Type I tip 3 3/4 in and taper 3 1/4 in, unlike current PC-1Q values 4 and 3 in. Its property table is retained as an independent historical cross-check, not a reason to change current dimensions.
No additional concrete junction fillets are dimensioned in PC-1Q; no unprinted fillets are introduced to fit published properties.
Strand locations, bar dimensions and concrete cover are reinforcement details, excluded from the gross concrete outline.
i_beam.calculated_properties_note: Gross properties of the implemented source-dimensional polygon in inch units; centroidal Ix. These calculated values and BDG residuals are not source dimensions.

i70.sheet: PC-2L PDF p1 SECTION B-B (midspan); no independent I70 property table was located in the reviewed BDG pages

geometry_notes: Vertical chain 6+2+1.5+49.5+3.5+7.5=70 in. The short upper haunch has a source horizontal run of 2 in and vertical rise of 1.5 in, followed by the main 10 in run / 2 in rise to the 30 in flange edge.
SECTION A-A has a 16 in end web; its exact flange/haunch intersection stations are not resolved. The implemented section is the 6 in midspan web only.
Bottom strand extent 11 spaces at 2 in =22 in within 26 in flange; printed 3/4 in soffit chamfers are retained.

beam_1800.sheet: PC-4J PDF p1 SECTION B-B; properties from BDG 6.60.02 p126

geometry_notes: PC-4J chain 3+2+54.5+5.5+5.875=70.875 in. The 3 in dimension is top-to-outer-edge underside; the 2 in dimension is the further drop to the theoretical upper web-haunch datum.
Both web junctions use the printed R7 7/8 in. Upper outer edge and lower outer slope junction use R2 in. Bottom-soffit corners are the printed 3/4 in BEVEL (TYP), not radius corners.
The dimensioned straight-line intersections determine tangent circular arcs; numerical convention is 16 chords per circular arc, without changing the printed radii.
Historical BDG 6.60.02 PDF p126 properties are checked independently; residuals are reported, never fitted away by modifying source dimensions.
The 4 ft 6 1/2 in datum chain was read directly and checked by full-depth closure; no vector-scale measurements are used.

bulb_tee.sheet: PC-5D PDF p1, lower SECTION A-A / B-B, blockouts in form:49 in top flange; independent properties from BDG 6.60.03 PDF p127 (05/22/23)
geometry_notes: All seven source depths 36,42,48,54,60,66,72 in use 49 in top flange,8 in web and40 in bottom flange with3/4 in soffit bevels. Only clear web height changes.
Upper chain 5+3+3=11 in; lower chain 5.5+7+2=14.5 in; clear web height is calculated as depth-25.5 in.
Upper horizontal run 17.5+3 in each side closes to49 in; lower run14+2 in each side closes to40 in.
The5 in upper thickness dimension is at the inner49 in blockout boundary, not the61 in outer edge.
The OR15-182 BTB002 overlapping template is a separate lineage; current geometry is directly sourced from PC-5D and checked against BDG6.60.03 properties.
